title: DE-4/2022/A8 DEPARTMENTAL EXAMINATION FOR JUNIOR MEMBERS OF I.A.S., I.P.S. AND I.F.S. - DECEMBER, 2021 - Division 'E' (Higher Standard) LAND LAWS (without books-25, with books-75)
questions: PART A (without books) 1. Explain the powers of the Collector in revision under the Survey and Boundaries Act.
2. Method of awarding compensation under the Kerala Land Development Act. Discuss
3. Condition for assignment of Land on registry. Explain.
4. Discuss the objects and reasons of the Kerala Conservation of Paddy Land and Wet Land Act, 2008.
5. The circumstances under which a ceiling case can be reopened under the KLR Act.
PART B (with books) 6. Briefly explain the procedure to be followed when lands are relinquished.
7. Explain how Data Bank is prepared under the conservation of Paddy Land and Wet Land Act, 2008 ?
8. What are the powers and functions of the District Expert Committee under the Protection of River Banks and Regulation of Removal of Sand Act 2001 ?
9. How the application for quarrying is disposed of by the Tahsildars ?
10. What are the Powers of a Land Tribunal under the KLR Act ?
11. What are the procedure for preparation of Survey map for Registration of Title deeds ?
